justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive scheme: schematic silhouette stick-figures with upraised arms, splayed legs and marked feet, one figure lifting a long straight pole/spear above the head, set among long incised lines and scattered small dots/signs on an open rock surface. The clearest difference in content is that B additionally includes boats with crew-stroke rows, a curved lur-like object and a disc-bodied figure, while A shows only the human figures and lines within its cropped view.
